landing.heroDesc: SmartStock uses AI to predict demand 30 days ahead, flag low stock, and send reorder alerts directly to your Telegram — so you never run out during Khmer New Year again.
landing.telegramAlertText: Blue T-Shirt (M) is running low. Order 25 units by Tuesday to avoid stockout.
landing.problemTitle: Running out of stock costs you money. Especially when you can't afford it.
landing.problemDesc: 70% of Cambodian SMEs still track inventory with notebooks and Excel. When Khmer New Year hits, they either run out of best-sellers or lock up cash in overstock.

problems.title: Guesswork reordering
problems.desc: "Should I call my supplier? I think we're low…" Then customers start asking and it's too late.

problems.title: Peak season disasters
problems.desc: Run out during Pchum Ben or 11.11 when demand spikes. Lost sales you'll never get back.

problems.title: Cash locked in overstock
problems.desc: Order too much to avoid stockouts, but now your money sits on shelves instead of working for you.

landing.howItWorksTitle: From manual tracking to intelligent decisions
landing.howItWorksDesc: Built for sellers who live on their phones, not desktop dashboards.

steps.title: Upload your sales data
steps.desc: Import from CSV, connect your POS, or paste Facebook Messenger orders. Our AI understands Khmer and English mixed messages.

steps.title: AI predicts demand
steps.desc: Get 30-day forecasts for every product. Our model knows Cambodia's calendar — Khmer New Year, Pchum Ben, 11.11 shopping events.

steps.title: Get alerts on Telegram
steps.desc: Every morning at 8 AM: "Blue T-Shirt (M) — Order 25 units by Tuesday." No desktop needed. Just tap, call your supplier, done.
